g.text: • Dual-stream design: Swin Transformer for FCS (frequency-hopping), ConvNeXt for VTS (wideband)
• Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) for multi-scale feature alignment
• Cross-attention fusion with adaptive weighting for missing VTS signals
• Temporal Transformer for Doppler effect modeling
• Open set recognition based on cosine distance thresholding
Processing: Dual-stream feature extraction → FPN alignment → Cross-attention fusion
Temporal modeling: Transformer encoder for sequence dependencies
Classification: Global pooling → FC layers → 24-class output
Open set: Cosine distance-based unknown detection (inference only)
